## Summary

I extended the business-day rule in `ClinicServiceImpl.toBusinessDay(...)` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`) so the registration-date adjustment now also rolls past public holidays, not just weekends.

**Changes:**
- Added a `HOLIDAYS` constant listing the five fixed public holidays: `2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`.
- Replaced the one-shot Saturday/Sunday branching with a loop that advances the date one day at a time while it falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or listed holiday — so a date landing on a holiday rolls forward to the next non-holiday business day (correctly handling consecutive holidays/weekends, e.g. a holiday adjacent to a weekend).

This mirrors the invariant the test harness encodes (`AcceptanceBase.toBusinessDay` / `HOLIDAYS`), and `./mvnw -o test` reports `BUILD SUCCESS` with all tests passing.
